note: The clearest out-of-ICP prospect in the batch, missing on all five stated criteria. He is a driver's education instructor who also delivers for Amazon, not a business owner, physician or equivalent. Income fails on every observable test — about $4,000 a month take-home, roughly $1,000 surplus while covering two households, $2,000 liquid and credit he describes as 'terrible'. Health is not the neglected corner of an otherwise good life; he is on blood pressure medication he wants to stop, carries an untreated meniscus tear and a heavy family history, so this is closer to a health crisis than to neglect. And the starting point is precisely the exclusion as stated on the ICP call: at six foot and 245-255 lb targeting 180-190 he is roughly 60 lb from goal and currently training zero days a week, which is the 'I need to just lose weight' case rather than good-to-great. The one qualification is that he is not gym-averse at all — he lost 100 lb on his own and works 65-75 hours a week — so the exclusion catches him on weight but not on attitude. Judged against the criteria as written rather than against his enthusiasm, this call should not have reached a price.
